description: A custom Android UI component extending ExoPlayer's DefaultTimeBar to render a rounded, pill-shaped track with a custom thumb, providing a styled time bar for media playback with specific drawing behavior and appearance.

classes.name: RoundedTimeBar
classes.description: A custom UI view for media progress with rounded track and custom thumb, extending ExoPlayer's DefaultTimeBar.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles custom drawing of the rounded track segments and thumb based on playback state.

methods.name: drawRoundedTrackAndThumb
methods.description: Draws the full track with unplayed, buffered, and played segments along with a fixed-radius thumb.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Updates current playback position, triggers redraw.
